mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (with p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (with p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% in the prior month (with p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain an accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 7.0% (with p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000 (with p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 (with p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market contraction regime (HOUST below 550,000 units), reduced housing activity dampens consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 550,000 (with p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a slowdown in GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates a broad economic contraction, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO declines and GDPC1 growth rate is below 0.5% (with p-value > 0.05 in t-test vs. baseline).
